title: SN 2023ixf: RLMT +5.4 to +50 d broadband photometry, saturation matrix and limits (MACRO Consortium release)
description: Machine-readable release accompanying the MACRO Consortium SN 2023ixf validation-and-limits paper: per-frame and nightly gri photometry from the 0.5 m Robert L. Mutel Telescope (Winer Observatory), calibration sets, filter crosswalk, template table, saturation matrix, residuals against Li et al. (2025), late-time limits, and the list of slot-6 grism frames not promoted. See README.md for column definitions and provenance.
notes: Released on behalf of the MACRO Consortium. Analysis code: https://github.com/jwwetzel/MACRO (pipeline/macro_sn, pipeline/scripts/run_sn_photometry.py).
